newsitem.title: UK: NatWest says Tesco link was conflict.
newsitem.headline: NatWest says Tesco link was conflict.

text.p: National Westminster Bank Plc said on Thursday it had decided not to join supermarket group Tesco Plc in an expansion into retail banking because the joint venture would have conflicted with the bank's strategy.

Tesco announced earlier that it has set a joint venture with Royal Bank of Scotland which would take over Tesco's ClubCard Plus interest paying account, which had previously involved NatWest, and launch a credit card.
Banking sources said NatWest was also worried that the venture with Tesco would have subsumed its brand name.
In a statement, Tim Jones, NatWest's director of retail banking services, said ClubCard Plus had been complimentary to the bank's plans but that the expansion did not fit its strategy.
"We have a very strong brand, over 300 years of banking expertise and a position that allows us to build our customer base," Jones said.

Jones said NatWest would do this by investing in staff and technology, providing more cash machines, increasing telephone operations and introducing electronic banking operations. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
